== Notes ==
{{bug|If your Mysticism is at 0, the skill will still remove an enchantment but only give 25% move speed instead of 50%.}}
* Pious Haste's conditional speed boost is enough to allow a [[character]] to pass through and trigger a [[trap]] without being affected.
* This skill increases average speed by '''<font color=green>4.17...25...29.17%</font>''' if used while enchanted with a Dervish enchantment every time it recharges.
** This stance can be maintained indefinitely under [[Dwarven Stability]].
* Consider combining with [[Zealous Renewal]].
